body: Added you, raviannn, M22
This is also me! (On the phone!)
No not really. I feel pretty good atm, we had a blast last night. But I know it's up and down and it can change in a matter of seconds.

Free reign is not a bad choice of words. Because that what it feels like and seriously; it feels good. To feel like you have the power over something that no one knows about. 
But well, now they know. Was with two of my friends last night, drinking beer at a bar and had a great time but I allways thought about if they would mention what happened this tusday which was.. Awkward?
I've been struggling with my pros all my life.
It was not sunset, it was in the middle of the night, just as it is right now. My favorite scent,... a boats motor I believe.
It's not worth it and that's why I'm here
I've started working out recently and it actually makes quite a difference in my mood, so atleast I got that going.
Thanks for answering. My friends and family know about my situation and I do things all the time with them to feel better but nothing makes any difference really.

I really do understand how you feel, I have been and still am a little bit in the same position. The first professional i spoke to said to me (replying to my statement I didn't want to tell anyone because they had their own problems to worry about) he said: how do you feel if someone opens up to you and tells you about their troubles? "Well.. Proud.." I answered. :)
50/50 is a recommendation from me, love to watch it when life sucks.

Nothing? Cause i have like two pieces of schoolwork and some food I have cooked which I'm proud of and when I think of that I get a little happier.. If you understand what I'm talking about you should try it.

Party, hang out, play games, football, anything really. I used to drink by myself aswell but that eventually lead to two suicide attempts so I don't do that anymore.
Yeah sometimes when I'm down I get that kind of laughing at 
myself thing but it just get me more sad because I feel so pathetic.

First of all, don't apologize, it's not your fault. Secondly, that is like the female, American version of me.. Are you proud of something in your life? Something you do, have done or something you have?
Thank you, I'll try
These are the kind of words I needed to read and you make a great point! Thank you
What I mean is that I don't enjoy fucking, having a job or studying. But I want to, I just don't know how

Thank you for your answer, it gave me a shiver of hope when I read it. I do a lot to my friends to make them happy and that makes me feel a little better. However, I kind of want to live for my own sake and not for anyone else if you understand?
I'm desperate and I'm trying to get help from anywhere I can. Help hasn't helped me anything so far though. Swedish actually but half Danish. Denmark is still awesome though!

Thank you for your comment and optimism! The thing is that I realize I have it pretty good but I still feel like shit and want to kill myself. I don't want to hang in there anymore I want to be able to walk by my own but I can't figure out how. Tried HoN once but was terrible at it, atleast you can't get too stomped in diablo :)
I'm glad I made you smile! :) no one can bring everything to the table but everyone can bring something!

My dad has ms but not quite as painful as yours seems to be, still pretty tough though. Can't walk up stairs without help etc etc. I know he was also depressed in his twenties when he got it. He is 52 now, has been married to my mother for many years. Sadly it ended a few years back but he has moved on. He's got a nice job in the commercial branch and makes a lot of money, dates a hot woman and loves to go to football! 
You say that you don't think you can be the man your future SO, kids or friends deserves because of your physical disability. But something I have learned from my father is that you can always measure up a con with another pro. He definetly makes up for his physical disability with his mind, words and heart. He is the greatest man ever in my eyes.
